name: autocad-mcp
description: An experimental Model Context Protocol bridge for full AutoCAD 2021-2026 on Windows
author: AutoCAD MCP Contributors

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: Report MCP server and AutoCAD availability.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List entities in the active AutoCAD document.

tools.name: get_entity_info
tools.description: Get information for an entity by its session-local identifier.

tools.name: generate_constrained_code
tools.description: Generate reviewed source text from bounded literal recipes; never execute it.

resources.description: Current MCP server and AutoCAD connection status

prompts.name: autocad-help
prompts.description: Get help with registered AutoCAD MCP tools

dependencies: Windows COM support for AutoCAD automation

steps: Install a targeted full AutoCAD 2021-2026 release on Windows
Install Python 3.12 or newer and uv
Install development dependencies with: uv sync --frozen --group dev
Start the stdio server with: uv run python -m autocad_mcp.server
